name: David Backshall
headline: VP Partnerships | Global Banking & Cross-Border Payments | SWIFT Partner Ecosystem | Stablecoins | Real-Time Payments | Speaker | Advisor
about:
With more than 20 years of experience in fintech, payments, banking, digital assets and financial technology. I have built, scaled, and transformed commercial organisations across global markets, driving growth for both venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses. Throughout my career, I have led high-performing teams, managed full P&L responsibility, developed GTM strategies, and delivered sustainable revenue growth by creating value for customers, partners, and shareholders.

As Vice President of Partnerships at TerraPay, I lead the company’s global banking and strategic partnership initiatives, helping financial institutions modernise cross-border payments through real-time payment networks, Stablecoins, digital wallets and RTP globally. TerraPay’s global payments ecosystem enables seamless, secure and instant money movement across more than 155 countries, connecting billions of bank accounts and digital wallets worldwide.

My expertise spans cross-border payments, correspondent banking, SWIFT, real-time payments, embedded finance, card issuing, acquiring, treasury solutions, trade finance, and emerging digital asset ecosystems. I work closely with banks, financial institutions, payment service providers, and fintechs to deliver innovative payment solutions that improve speed, transparency, access, and cost efficiency.

I am passionate about the future of global payments and the convergence of traditional financial infrastructure with emerging technologies, including stablecoins, digital assets, AI-driven commerce, and next-generation payment networks. My focus is on helping financial institutions navigate this transformation while advancing financial inclusion and enabling greater global connectivity.
